## WARCORE: Armored Warfare

Turn-based tank artillery for Windows and the web. Your account works in both: sign in with the same name at [war-core.online](https://war-core.online/play/) or in the Windows app.

### Install on Windows
Download **WARCORE_…_x64-setup.exe** below and run it. The installer isn't code-signed yet, so if Windows says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. The `.msi` is the same game for managed installs.

### What's in this version
- **Ranked online:** quick matches pair you with players near your rating. Climb from Bronze to Diamond. Room codes for friendly matches are still there.
- **Leaderboards** for rank, online wins and best arcade run, in the game and on war-core.online.
- **Daily reward** with a streak bonus, and **three daily missions**.
- **VIP membership:** double coins, the VIP Obsidian paint and Crown decal, and a VIP badge.
- **Cheat-proof coins:** the server decides every reward and purchase.
- **New weapons:** Airstrike, Homing Missile and Teleporter.
- **New maps:** Night Ops, Volcano and Ruined City.
- **New tanks:** Howitzer (long range) and Titan (super-heavy).
- **Vivid HDR-style colours** with glow on fire and explosions (Settings > Colors switches back to Natural).
- New WARCORE app icon.
